description: Scheduler-fired EDGE_SINK target of the model capability guard cron (default daily at 05:30 UTC). Hands one catalog refresh and renewal check to a single-slot background thread and returns immediately with dispatch=started, already_running (the previous check is still running) or inactive (this is the inactive blue-green colour). The background check refreshes the model capability catalog, classifies it ok, warning or critical, and alerts the role named by this plugin's 'alert_role' config key on a severity transition; a failure inside it is logged at ERROR with its traceback. Declares no result or error processor, so a fire stays terminal. Cron-only wiring (is_discoverable=False); call check_model_capability_catalog to run the check directly and see its result.
embedding_description: Cron-only fire for the model capability catalog guard: starts one background refresh of the capability catalog that classifies it ok, warning or critical and alerts the configured role on a severity transition. Not model-callable; the direct equivalent is check_model_capability_catalog.
